values.note: Online on koa.com or at 828-686-3121. The booking form required 2 nights for a July 2027 Saturday and none for an April Tuesday; other weekends not probed. Extended stays offered too.

note: KOA Holiday at 2708 Highway 70 East, Swannanoa, along the Swannanoa River (riverside sites A1-A10 and B28-B29). Reopened in October 2025 after Hurricane Helene flood damage; in October 2026 KOA still says some areas, including the lakes, are being repaired and are off limits. --Claude
